name: Testudo Helmet Clanguard
description:
Item Type: Medium Armor
Damage Reduction: 30%
Temp. Rating: -50 / 80 °C
Radiation Protection: 26400 REM
Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s 

Keep your eyes on the prize and your head protected with the Testudo helmet. It features a wide faceplate and a durable outer shell that protrudes above the forehead in a way specifically designed to absorb and efficiently disperse the energy of impacts. The Clanguard version has been modified with Vanduul materials and alien artifacts.
